items.t: Second gear can overheat and break inside the automatic transmission
items.note: Recall 04V176 added a cooler fix and covered damaged units. Check the VIN. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, shudder or failure
items.note: Mild shudder may ease with a fluid change. A used or rebuilt unit costs less than a new dealer unit.

items.t: Power steering pump whine and leaks
items.note: If only the inlet hose or its seal leaks, the repair costs much less than a new pump.

items.t: Key can come out of the ignition when not in Park
items.note: Free under recall 12V573 for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Air bags may go off without a crash
items.note: Free under recall 15V045. Check the VIN and have it done right away.

items.t: Stability control can apply the brakes on its own
items.note: Free under recall 13V092 for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Battery drain from the Hands Free Link module
items.job: Test for battery drain and replace Hands Free Link module
items.note: Some owners just unplug the module, which costs far less but turns off Bluetooth calls.

items.t: Side mirror motor noise or failure
items.note: Price is per mirror. A whole mirror assembly costs more.

items.t: A/C works on and off or battery drains from A/C relay
items.job: Test and replace A/C compressor clutch relay

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Many owners just top up oil and replace fouled plugs. A replacement engine can cost more.

items.t: Active damper shocks wear out
items.job: Replace one active damper strut or shock
items.note: Price is per corner, plus an alignment. Kits to convert to regular shocks can cost less.

items.t: Torque converter shudder at cruising speeds
items.job: Transmission fluid flush per service bulletin
items.note: If the shudder stays, the torque converter or transmission may need replacing, which costs much more.

items.t: Driveshaft bolts may loosen on AWD models
items.note: Free under recall 13V571. Check the VIN first. Cost rises if the driveshaft was damaged.

items.t: Rear subframe can rust through
items.note: Recall 26V365 inspects and repairs or replaces the subframe for free. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tailgate lights fail from water getting in
items.job: Repair tailgate light wiring and seal out water
items.note: Covered by recalls 19V256 and 25V259 for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rough or jerky shifts from the 9-speed automatic
items.note: Updates are often free under warranty or bulletin. Ask the dealer. Internal repairs cost much more.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing failure
items.note: Recall 23V751 inspects and repairs or replaces the engine for free. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
items.note: Free under recalls 19V060, 21V215 and 23V858 for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine doesn't restart after Auto Idle Stop
items.job: Update engine software per service bulletin
items.note: If the starter or battery is also weak, replacing it costs more.

items.t: Collision braking system brakes for no reason
items.job: Update software and recalibrate radar and camera
items.note: If the radar or camera unit has failed, replacing it costs much more.

items.t: Timing belt teeth can separate
items.note: Free under recall 19V298, including any engine damage. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Check engine light from a sticking purge valve
items.note: Ask the dealer about bulletin B23-035 before paying.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor can crack and set off air bags
items.note: Free under recalls 24V064 and 26V332. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Type S engine can stall from fuel injection software error
items.note: Free under recall 25V031. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out
items.note: Free under recall 26V721. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pivot pin may not be secured
items.job: Inspect and secure brake pedal pivot pin (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V391. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Center screen can go blank and lose the backup camera
items.note: Free under recall 25V032. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front coil spring can corrode and break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 05V-385. Check the VIN first.
